lines.gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: nat mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Nat, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaar vaar jaau gur gopaal ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Guru, the Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਤੁਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mohi niragun tum pooran daate deenaa naath daiaal ||1||
lines.translation: I am unworthy; You are the Perfect Giver. You are the Merciful Master of the meek. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨ ਮਾਲ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: oothat baithat sovat jaagat jee praan dhan maal ||2||
lines.translation: While standing up and sitting down, while sleeping and awake, You are my soul, my breath of life, my wealth and property. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਪਿਆਸ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੩॥੮॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: darasan piaas bahut man merai naanak daras nihaal ||3||8||9||
lines.translation: Within my mind there is such a great thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. Nanak is enraptured with Your Glance of Grace. ||3||8||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: nat paRataal mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Nat Partaal, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਊ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੋ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooo hai mero saajan meet ||
lines.translation: Is there any friend or companion of mine,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਨੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam sunaavai neet ||
lines.translation: who will constantly share the Lord's Name with me?

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: binasai dukh bipareet ||
lines.translation: Will he rid me of my pains and evil tendencies?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh arapau man tan cheet ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I would surrender my mind, body, consciousness and everything. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਆਪਨ ਕੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: koee viralaa aapan keet ||
lines.translation: How rare is that one whom the Lord makes His own,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)g charan kamal man seet ||
lines.translation: and whose mind is sewn into the Lord's Lotus Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਦੀਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa har jas deet ||1||
lines.translation: Granting His Grace, the Lord blesses him with His Praise. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਜਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bhaj janam padaarath jeet ||
lines.translation: Vibrating, meditating on the Lord, he is victorious in this precious human life,

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਹੋਹਿ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot patit hohi puneet ||
lines.translation: and millions of sinners are sanctified.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਕੀਤ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੦॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daas bal bal keet ||2||1||10||19||
lines.translation: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him. ||2||1||10||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: nat asatapadeeaa mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Nat Ashtpadheeyaa, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam mere man tan naam adhaare ||
lines.translation: O Lord, Your Name is the support of my mind and body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: khin pal rahi na sakau bin sevaa mai guramat naam samhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I cannot survive for a moment, even for an instant, without serving You. Following the Guru's Teachings, I dwell upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har har har har man dhiaavahu mai har har naam piaare ||
lines.translation: Within my mind, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har. The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is so dear to me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaal bhae prabh thaakur gur kai sabad savaare ||1||
lines.translation: When God, my Lord and Master, became merciful to me the meek one, I was exalted by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਧਸੂਦਨ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਮਾਧੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: madhasoodan jagajeevan maadho mere thaakur agam apaare ||
lines.translation: Almighty Lord, Slayer of demons, Life of the World, my Lord and Master, inaccessible and infinite:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਬਿਨਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਮੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ik binau benatee karau gur aagai mai saadhoo charan pakhaare ||2||
lines.translation: I offer this one prayer to the Guru, to bless me, that I may wash the feet of the Holy. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahas netr netr hai prabh kau prabh eko purakh niraare ||
lines.translation: The thousands of eyes are the eyes of God; the One God, the Primal Being, remains unattached.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sahas moorat eko prabh thaakur prabh eko guramat taare ||3||
lines.translation: The One God, our Lord and Master, has thousands of forms; God alone, through the Guru's Teachings, saves us. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਮੋਦਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramat naam damodar paaiaa har har naam ur dhaare ||
lines.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, I have been blessed with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I have enshrined within my heart the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਬਨੀ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਜਿਉ ਗੂੰਗਾ ਗਟਕ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: har har kathaa banee at meethee jiu goo(n)gaa gatak samhaare ||4||
lines.translation: The sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is so very sweet; like the mute, I taste its sweetness, but I cannot describe it at all. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਦ ਚਖੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਅਤਿ ਫੀਕੇ ਲੋਭ ਬਿਕਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa saad chakhai bhaai doojai at pheeke lobh bikaare ||
lines.translation: The tongue savors the bland, insipid taste of the love of duality, greed and corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਦ ਚਖਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਸਭ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jo guramukh saad chakhahi raam naamaa sabh an ras saad bisaare ||5||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh tastes the flavor of the Lord's Name, and all other tastes and flavors are forgotten. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਣਿ ਕਹਤਿਆ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramat raam naam dhan paaiaa sun kahatiaa paap nivaare ||
lines.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, I have obtained the wealth of the Lord's Name; hearing it, and chanting it, sins are eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: dharam raai jam neR na aavai mere thaakur ke jan piaare ||6||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death and the Righteous Judge of Dharma do not even approach the beloved servant of my Lord and Master. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਮੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saas saas saas hai jete mai guramat naam samhaare ||
lines.translation: With as many breaths as I have, I chant the Naam, under Guru's Instructions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੋ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਾਸੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: saas saas jaai naamai bin so birathaa saas bikaare ||7||
lines.translation: Each and every breath which escapes me without the Naam - that breath is useless and corrupt. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੇਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kripaa kripaa kar deen prabh saranee mo kau har jan mel piaare ||
lines.translation: Please grant Your Grace; I am meek; I seek Your Sanctuary, God. Unite me with Your beloved, humble servants.
